description: Called once at UI startup (ui.main). Makes a process restart recoverable: a run that was 'running' when the process died is otherwise permanently stuck, since nothing else would ever transition it out of 'running'.
docstring:
Mark any run left 'running' by a dead process as failed, so it becomes resumable.

Args:
    conn: An open connection, used only for the duration of this call.

Returns:
    The run_ids that were reconciled (marked failed). Empty list if none were orphaned.

Sequence:
    1. candidates = [r for r in storage.list_runs(conn) with unbounded limit if r.status in ('pending', 'running')].
    2. live = set(active_run_ids()).
    3. For each candidate not in live: storage.update_run_status(conn, r.run_id, 'failed', error_message='process terminated before completion'); for each of that run's run_stages rows with status='running', storage.finish_run_stage(conn, r.run_id, stage, 'failed', error_message='process terminated before completion').
    4. Return the list of reconciled run_ids.

Called exactly once per process start, before build_navigation, since the run list and detail pages must never show a run stuck in 'running' with no way to ever change.
preconditions: Called before any new run is started in this process (so active_run_ids() has not yet accumulated entries for runs started in the current process that would otherwise be misclassified as orphaned)
postconditions: After this call, no run in the database has status 'running' or 'pending' unless it is also present in active_run_ids()
Every reconciled run's non-succeeded run_stages rows are also marked 'failed', never left dangling at 'running'

edge_cases.input: No orphaned runs exist (clean prior shutdown, or a fresh database)
A run is genuinely live in THIS process (started moments before reconcile_orphaned_runs runs, e.g. a race during startup)
edge_cases.expected_behavior: not reconciled -- it is present in active_run_ids() and therefore excluded from candidates

edge_cases.input: A run stuck 'pending' (crashed during preflight, before any run_stages row existed)
edge_cases.expected_behavior: reconciled to 'failed' with the same error_message; there are no run_stages rows to also update in this case

edge_cases.input: Called a second time in the same process after already reconciling once
edge_cases.expected_behavior: no-op the second time -- the previously orphaned runs are now 'failed', not 'pending'/'running', so they are no longer candidates

unit_tests.name: test_orphaned_running_run_marked_failed
unit_tests.description: A fixture run with status='running' and no entry in active_run_ids() is marked 'failed' with the fixed error_message.

unit_tests.name: test_orphaned_run_stages_also_marked_failed
unit_tests.description: A reconciled run's run_stages row that was 'running' is also marked 'failed'.

unit_tests.name: test_live_run_not_reconciled
unit_tests.description: A run present in active_run_ids() is left untouched even though its status is 'running'.
unit_tests.expected: runs.status unchanged, run_id not in the returned list

unit_tests.name: test_pending_orphan_reconciled_with_no_stage_rows
unit_tests.description: A run stuck 'pending' with zero run_stages rows is reconciled without error.
unit_tests.expected: runs.status == 'failed', no exception from the empty stage update loop

unit_tests.name: test_no_orphans_returns_empty_list
unit_tests.description: A database with only 'succeeded'/'failed'/'cancelled' runs returns [].
